approve_action.description: Approve an action a run holds (run_id and item_id from list_actions): it is published to the workflow's mission control connections as approved advice, and cannot be rejected afterwards. A swap advises adding a backup pass or moving to it (action add or move); Constellation books and cancels nothing, the operator's systems decide what to do with it. An action on the demo fleet is recorded but sent nowhere: feed_cursor is null and held_as_demo true. The approval stands for the same action on the workflow's later runs. Needs the Operator + Act plan (403 plan_required below it), the act:approve scope and a live key.

create_scenario.description: Create a scenario overlay: antennas taken down, and extra attenuation in dB per antenna. Returns a scenario_id for run_workflow. Requires the config:write scope.

TimedFade.description: Rain over one antenna from from_utc to to_utc, as lanes.Fade prices it.
TimedFade.title: TimedFade

get_network_config.description: The caller's network config: its ground stations with their antennas, and its satellites with their radios. version picks an older one; the latest otherwise. Contact predictions run over the antennas and satellites named here.

get_passes.description: Every pass of the network config's satellites over its antennas between from and to, from the live orbit catalog and each antenna's elevation mask, sampled every step_s seconds. Each pass carries the pass_id a run's item for it carries. satellite_id and antenna_id narrow it. Below the Operator plan it covers at most 2 satellites of the caller's own; the demo fleet's are free. Every time carries a UTC offset. Requires the topology:read scope.

get_predictions.description: Forecasts from Constellation's models. For snr (the default family), ask by instant: pass at (a future UTC instant) with a satellite_id, a ground_station_id or ground_antenna_id, or both sides. Each link up then comes back with snr_db_p50 in dB (optical links, 3000 GHz or more: rx_power_dbm_p50 in dBm, clear sky); a link not up is listed in entity_errors (no_visible_pass), so pick a time in a pass. link_ids is the other snr form, for links sending telemetry now: ground antenna ids (see get_topology), forecast a few minutes past their latest telemetry; one with no telemetry in the last minute answers no_telemetry. Up to 100 ids per call, at most 25 without a stored forecast computed in one call. Ids not answered are in entity_errors with a code and a message saying what to do: rate_limited (held by a cooldown or a cap), timeout (the model did not answer in time) or prediction_unavailable (a serving failure). When none succeed for those reasons the call answers HTTP 429, 504 or 503 with Retry-After. Retry only the failed ids, after a short pause, not in a loop. weather-attenuation takes at and a ground_station_id, a satellite_id or both: the slant-path attenuation in dB of each link in view on a common band. rfi takes at, a ground_station_id, one ground_antenna_id and a satellite_id: rfi_penalty_db and p_interference. ssa takes at (within 7 days of now) and a satellite_id, optionally a ground_station_id: its contacts in progress, with p_track, the chance the antenna holds it through the pass. demand takes target_at, a satellite_id and optionally a ground_station_id: p_free, the share of the pass's antenna time it can expect under contention. Only snr takes link_ids. Requires the predictions:read scope.

as_of_utc.description: Return the prediction that existed at this past instant.

at.description: The UTC instant to forecast at: required for weather-attenuation, rfi and snr by instant, which need it later than now, and for ssa, which takes it within 7 days of now, past or future. Not taken by demand, which takes target_at.

ground_antenna_id.description: Ground antenna ids from the network config: for snr with at (not with ground_station_id), and exactly one for rfi.

ground_station_id.description: A ground station id from the network config: required for rfi, optional for weather-attenuation, ssa, demand and snr with at.

horizon_minutes.description: Forecast horizon. Omit to let the model choose.

link_ids.description: snr from live telemetry: ground antenna ids sending telemetry now. Not taken by the other families.

model_family.description: snr (default) for link SNR, weather-attenuation for a link's attenuation at one instant, rfi for a link's interference at one instant, ssa for a satellite's contacts in progress at one instant, or demand for a satellite's pass and its share of antenna time.

satellite_id.description: A satellite id from the network config: required for rfi, ssa and demand, optional for weather-attenuation and snr with at.

target_at.description: demand only: the future UTC instant of the pass to price.

get_run.description: A run by run_id, or a workflow's newest finished run by its slug (workflow; 409 no_finished_run until one finishes). Answers the run's status (queued, running, done, failed or cancelled) and, when done, its items: each names its entity (type pass, link or antenna, with its ids) and target_at, with its value in value.p50 (p10 and p90 equal it until a model returns a spread) and the explain ledger naming each model's value and source. A held action on an item carries its action_status. A run can hold thousands of items, so read them in pages: page_records items from page (next_page while more are left), and narrow with satellite_id, antenna_id, station_id or pass_id. Not counted as a prediction. Requires the predictions:read scope and a live key.

get_telemetry.description: Link telemetry written with send_telemetry between start and end, one record per time and id set, oldest first. Set interval and agg to aggregate numeric fields into windows; a raw read spans at most an hour. Requires the topology:read scope.

get_topology.description: The fleet as declared and as observed, from GET /topology: config is the latest network config ({version, document}; null when there is none or the key lacks config:read), and state is the newest value of each field per ground antenna and satellite reported within freshness_seconds (default 300, at most 3600). An empty state means nothing has reported in the window. Requires the topology:read scope.

get_usage.description: The caller's account: plan and this month's usage per unit (predictions, chat turns, telemetry points) and when the month resets. Predictions and telemetry are counted, never capped. Chat turns are Ask Constellation questions, capped per plan: limit and remaining say how many.

list_actions.description: The actions a workflow's current run holds for approval (swap advice), each pending, approved, rejected, expired or unavailable (its offer's ground network link was deleted), with the deadline to decide by, its action_id and, once decided, its decision_id. An action on the demo fleet is held_as_demo: recorded, never sent. Once bridges report on the decision, outcomes lists each connection's outcome (acted or refused, with reason), and outcome says refused if any refused. A run holds an action when its workflow has a policy step in approve mode. Requires the predictions:read scope and a live key.

list_workflows.description: The caller's saved workflows (the Platform's Automations), the latest version of each, as a name and a node graph. With templates true, the read-only templates instead (pass-yield, antenna-capacity, modcod-plan, rain-fade-swap, audit-ledger, and rfi-watch, available false where no rfi model is served) and the models a run here prices, each with why where it does not; copy a template by saving its graph with put_workflow under your own slug. Requires the config:read, config:write or workflows:write scope and a live key.

load_demo_fleet.description: Load the demo fleet into the caller's account: 5 ground stations with 7 antennas and 6 satellites (5 sun-synchronous Earth observation satellites on X and Ka band and GOES 19 on L band; ids norad-<NORAD id>), marked demo so they never count toward the plan, and two hours of simulated link telemetry ending now. It also saves the demo workflows pass-yield and rain-fade-swap and the scenario "Storm over Singapore tonight" (scn_demo-storm-singapore). Safe to repeat: it adds only what is missing and rewrites the same points. A config that uses a demo id for its own entity, or a demo satellite's NORAD id, is refused (409 demo_ids_taken, with the ids and a message). The low-orbit links are up only during passes: ask get_predictions with at, at a time in a pass get_passes lists. Mission names are real; the telemetry is simulated. Needs config:write and telemetry:write; without telemetry:write the rest is written and the call says the telemetry was refused.

patch_network_config.description: Merge a JSON merge patch into the caller's network config and store it as a new version: add or change ground stations, antennas and satellites. A satellite takes a norad_id or a tle. A satellite with catalog {norad_id} or a station with catalog {station_id} (from search_catalog) is filled from the catalog where the document leaves fields out; the document's own fields win and radio values are never filled. Requires the config:write scope.

put_workflow.description: Save a workflow under a slug as a new version: a name and a graph of nodes ({id, kind, ref, params, position}) and edges ({id, from: {node, port}, to: {node, port}}). Kinds: input (passes or links: step_s, satellite_ids, antenna_ids), lane (the model a step reads: snr, weather, demand, rfi, ssa), transform (sinr, capacity, success, expected_gb, sum_by, modcod_schedule, swap, ledger, lock_loss), condition (threshold: column, quantile, op, value; ports true and false), output (predictions, exactly one; feed; destination). Start from a template's graph (list_workflows with templates true). A graph with issues is refused with each one. A slug whose workflow was deleted is refused (404 unknown_workflow) unless create is true, which starts a new workflow under it with none of the deleted one's runs or decisions. Requires the workflows:write or config:write scope and a live key.

create.description: Start a new workflow under a slug whose workflow was deleted; not needed for a slug never used.

reject_action.description: Reject an action a run holds (run_id and item_id from list_actions). It cannot be undone: the action is never sent, it cannot be decided again, and later runs hold the same action back as rejected. Requires the act:approve scope and a live key.

run_workflow.description: Start a run of a saved workflow over a UTC window (from and to) or at one time (at), optionally against a scenario_id. Returns a run_id for get_run; the run queues and runs in the background. Every time carries a UTC offset. A run sends its results to the workflow's mission control connections and destinations unless deliver is false (a test run: it prices and stores its items and sends nothing); a run against a scenario is always a test run. A run that delivers needs the Operator plan or above (403 plan_required). A run computes at most 4,000,000 link steps (links times steps): more is refused with 422 too_many_link_steps and a suggested_step_s that fits. Requires the workflows:write scope and a live key.

search_catalog.description: Search the public asset catalog to build a fleet from it: kind satellites (by NORAD id, with downlink bands) or stations (ground stations, with receive bands, coordinates and antenna counts). q matches name, id or operator; operator, fleet and band (S, X, Ka) filter; near (lat,lon) with within_km finds stations nearest first. Pages of limit (default 50) with next_cursor. Add a pick with patch_network_config: a satellite {"catalog": {"norad_id": N}}, a station {"catalog": {"station_id": id}}. Requires the topology:read scope.

send_telemetry.description: Write link telemetry keyed by the caller's network config: up to 1,000 records per call. Each record names a ground_station_id, one of its ground_antenna_ids and a satellite_id, as the network config has them. Antenna fields: azimuth_deg, elevation_deg, tracking_error_az_deg, tracking_error_el_deg, track_mode, range_m, range_rate_m_s. Carrier fields: carrier_locked, subcarrier_locked, symbol_locked, frame_locked, c_n0_dbhz, es_n0_db, rx_power_dbm, frequency_ghz, carrier_offset_hz, frames_delivered, frames_good, uplink_status, modcod, tx_power_dbm, ber, per, system_noise_temp_k, noise_power_dbm, noise_diode_on. The records that pass are written; rejected_indices and rejections name the rest with each index, field and reason. The call is an error only when no record passes, or a record does not match the schema. Requires the telemetry:write scope.
